summary: Measure bounded cluster rejoin under transient catalog BUSY

delivery.outcome: A measured and still bounded client retry window for transient explicit catalog BUSY during three-node rejoin, retaining failures and cleanup evidence.
nonGoals: Changing Taskand gateway capacity or protocol
Retrying generic HTTP failures or uncertain effects

architecture.decision: Increase only the fixture client's explicit catalog BUSY retry budget from four to seven calls, with 5.25 seconds total scheduled backoff and per-attempt elapsed observations. Keep all other HTTP outcomes terminal. Preserve historical failed reports and full resource cleanup checks.
architecture.rollback: Revert the test client change; preserve all recorded run reports.

validation.evidence: Exact-source cluster report with attempts and cleanup, focused peer-backpressure tests and governance
